composition.serve_who: This sheet (GMMS 108'-124 "COCKPIT HYDRAULIC CONTROL PANELS") documents two mirrored cockpit control panels — PORT and STBD — each with a 9-button "SAILING FUNCTIONS" switch/LED array (FURL JIB, STAYSAIL(FURL STAYSAIL), JIB TACK UP/DOWN, JIB SHEET UP/DOWN, IN/OUT) that commands the sailing hydraulic furlers/cylinders via a shared AFT MYT PLC J/BOX (PLC I/O node feeding MYT hydraulics manifolds). Each button labeled FURL/STAYSAIL corresponds to the Bamar furling units (860-bamar-gfsi30 jib furler, 860-bamar-sit20 staysail furler, and by extension 860-bamar-pi20 code-0), JIB TACK UP/DOWN and JIB SHEET IN/OUT/UP/DOWN correspond to the Cariboni hydraulic cylinders (840-cariboni-hydraulic-cylinders) already confirmed for these buttons in engineer mappings. The PLC J/BOX itself is part of the MYT hydraulic control/PLC infrastructure (570-myt-systems-hydraulics / 570-plc-rack-aft), and the panels' own LED indicator/backlighting/terminal-strip wiring is panel infrastructure, not equipment.

equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: The 'FURL' / 'JIB' pushbutton row on both PORT and STBD sailing-function panels is engineer-confirmed as the cockpit control for the Bamar GFSI 30 jib furler (per established facts). Command travels from the panel pushbutton through the numbered terminal block onto the MU-X1P/S multi-core cable into the AFT MYT PLC J/BOX DI channels.

functions.label: Furl/unfurl JIB command
functions.what_it_does: Cockpit pushbutton (JIB, row 2 on both panels) sends a momentary command to furl/unfurl the jib via the MYT hydraulic PLC; a RED LED at the panel indicates the button/function is engaged.

flow_scenarios.path: no button pressed -> no signal on JIB terminal -> furler idle

JIB pushbutton pressed (PORT panel terminal 2 / STBD panel terminal 2) -> panel wiring -> MU-X1P/MU-X1S multi-core cable -> AFT MYT PLC J/BOX DI input -> MYT hydraulic control energises jib furler function (detailed on hydraulic block sheet, cross-referenced)

key_components: AFT MYT PLC J/BOX DI input
functions.sheet_region: PORT panel terminal 2 (bbox ~0-0.3,0.19-0.44); STBD panel terminal 2 (bbox ~0.7-1.0,0.19-0.44)

equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: The 'STAYSAIL' pushbutton row (terminal 3, both panels) is engineer-confirmed as the cockpit control for the Bamar SIT 20 staysail furler.

functions.label: Furl/unfurl STAYSAIL command
functions.what_it_does: Cockpit pushbutton (STAYSAIL, row 3 on both panels) sends a command to furl/unfurl the staysail via the MYT hydraulic PLC; RED LED indicates engagement.

flow_scenarios.path: no button pressed -> no signal -> furler idle
STAYSAIL pushbutton pressed (terminal 3) -> panel wiring -> MU-X1P/MU-X1S cable -> AFT MYT PLC J/BOX DI input -> MYT hydraulic control energises staysail furler function

key_components: AFT MYT PLC J/BOX DI input
functions.sheet_region: PORT panel terminal 3; STBD panel terminal 3

equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: JIB TACK UP and JIB TACK DOWN pushbuttons are engineer-confirmed cockpit controls for the Cariboni hydraulic cylinder(s) actuating the jib tack line, on both PORT and STBD panels (terminals 4 and 5).

functions.label: Jib Tack UP/DOWN command
functions.what_it_does: Pushbuttons raise/lower the jib tack via a Cariboni hydraulic cylinder, commanded through the AFT MYT PLC J/BOX.

flow_scenarios.path: no button pressed -> cylinder holds position
JIB TACK UP pressed (terminal 4) -> panel wiring -> MU-X1P/S cable -> AFT MYT PLC J/BOX DI input -> MYT hydraulic control extends/retracts Cariboni cylinder (UP direction)
JIB TACK DOWN pressed (terminal 5) -> panel wiring -> MU-X1P/S cable -> AFT MYT PLC J/BOX DI input -> MYT hydraulic control drives Cariboni cylinder (DOWN direction)

key_components: AFT MYT PLC J/BOX DI input
functions.sheet_region: PORT panel terminals 4-5; STBD panel terminals 4-5

equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: JIB SHEET UP/DOWN and IN/OUT pushbuttons are engineer-confirmed cockpit controls for the Cariboni hydraulic cylinder(s) actuating the jib sheet, on both PORT and STBD panels (terminals 6,7,8,9). One relay bank (Re1-Re4) inside the AFT MYT PLC J/BOX with contacts tied to DI-05 CH12 and an output flagged 'MYT' appears to be part of the OUT/sheet-out command chain, feeding onward to STBD PEDESTAL J/BOX 3.

functions.label: Jib Sheet UP/DOWN command
functions.what_it_does: Pushbuttons drive the jib sheet cylinder up/down.

flow_scenarios.path: JIB SHEET UP pressed (terminal 6) -> panel wiring -> MU-X1P/S cable -> AFT MYT PLC J/BOX DI input -> MYT hydraulic control drives Cariboni jib sheet cylinder UP
JIB SHEET DOWN pressed (terminal 7) -> panel wiring -> MU-X1P/S cable -> AFT MYT PLC J/BOX DI input -> MYT hydraulic control drives Cariboni jib sheet cylinder DOWN

key_components: AFT MYT PLC J/BOX DI input
functions.sheet_region: PORT panel terminals 6-7; STBD panel terminals 6-7

functions.label: Jib Sheet IN/OUT command
functions.what_it_does: Pushbuttons trim the jib sheet in or out; the OUT command is relayed through Re2/Re3/Re4 relay bank in the PLC J/BOX (each relay's contact loops through a RED LED indicator to DI-05 CH12, and the common junction ties to a terminal marked 'MYT') before continuing to a downstream 6-way terminal block that runs 'to STBD PEDESTAL J/BOX 3'.

flow_scenarios.path: no button pressed -> sheet holds position
IN pressed (terminal 8, both panels) -> panel wiring -> MU-X1P/S cable -> AFT MYT PLC J/BOX DI-04 CH07 (PORT) / DI-05 CH04 (STBD) input -> MYT hydraulic control trims sheet IN

OUT pressed (terminal 9, both panels) -> panel wiring -> MU-X1P/S cable -> AFT MYT PLC J/BOX DI input -> relay bank Re2/Re3/Re4 (each contact in series with a RED LED status indicator feeding DI-05 CH12) -> common junction to terminal marked 'MYT' -> onward via 6-way terminal block to STBD PEDESTAL J/BOX 3 (continuation off-sheet)

key_components: RED LED status indicators on Re2/Re3/Re4 contacts
functions.sheet_region: PORT/STBD panel terminals 8-9; relay bank Re1-Re4 inside AFT MYT PLC J/BOX (bbox ~0.47-0.58,0.73-0.83)

facts: 9-button pushbutton array (FURL/JIB, STAYSAIL, JIB TACK UP/DOWN, JIB SHEET UP/DOWN, IN, OUT) each with a RED LED indicator, wired through a 12-pin terminal block
A secondary 6-pin terminal block carries +/- supply and BACK LIGHTING +/-
Panel connects onward via 2-conductor multi-core cable MU-X1P and MU-X2P into the AFT MYT PLC J/BOX

infrastructure.system_name: AFT MYT PLC J/BOX (PLC I/O terminal enclosure)
facts: Dotted-boundary enclosure with separate PORT and STBD 12-pin terminal columns mapped to PLC DI/DO channels: PORT pin1=DI-04 CH07, pin10=+24V PLC, pin11=DO-01 CH13; STBD pin1=DI-05 CH04, pin10=+24V PLC, pin11=DO-01 CH16
Contains relay bank Re1-Re4 with contacts wired to DI-05 CH12 (status)
Feeds a downstream 6-way terminal block (pin1 tied to 'MYT' flag) whose cable continues off-sheet 'to STBD PEDESTAL J/BOX 3' (cross-reference)
This J/BOX is the shared PLC infrastructure for both PORT and STBD cockpit panels, not itself an item of equipment

cross_references.what: AFT MYT PLC J/BOX PORT/STBD DI/DO channel mapping (DI-04 CH07, DI-05 CH04, DI-05 CH12, DO-01 CH13, DO-01 CH16) continuing into MYT hydraulic manifold control logic
